Firefox Desktop DAU and MAU through 2027, on Glean-equivalent history

A draft forecast of desktop MAU (headline, raw daily rolling-28 MAU on 2027-12-15) and DAU (28-day trailing mean), trained on the legacy-to-glean project's Glean-equivalent history (Legacy telemetry restated the way Glean counts, Fx 148–153 reference state) as if it were real Glean history, because Glean desktop telemetry is too short to train on and Legacy ends in 2026. Not a monthly cycle: no head- or tailwinds are applied; the one adjustment in the build is a data correction for China's June 2026 MozillaOnline migration step. Mobile is not covered.

Uncertainty shown is the translation band only — the export project's own statement of how far the Glean-equivalent history may be off (half-width in % of the series, held at its last delivered value). It says nothing about forecast error. The model's Prophet predictive band is not reported: at a 15-month horizon it is ±94M on world MAU (±20M even on production's own Legacy build), which is not an uncertainty statement anyone can use. A backtest-based forecast error (how far 12–15-month-ahead forecasts from past seams missed) is the agreed next step and is not in this copy.

4. What the China correction did

China's desktop DAU doubled in June 2026 when MozillaOnline users migrated onto mainline Firefox (visible on Windows and Mac, and on MAU, in the Glean-equivalent data). Left in the training rows, the raw model mis-estimated China's holidays (China DAU to a 450K monthly mean in October 2027), produced negative China tiles, and let China's sample paths dominate every interval. The correction subtracts the measured migration curve from China's training rows before the model runs and adds it back after, on both metrics, split across Windows (96.5% DAU / 96.2% MAU) and Mac. The MAU curve is derived: the DAU curve's trailing 28-day mean × 2.894, China's own measured MAU-per-DAU of the migrated users (windows 2.88, mac 3.20, against baselines of 3.74 / 3.41). Nobody has measured MozillaOnline MAU directly.

Because mozaic reconciles top-down, removing the step from the world series lowers the world trend and that is pushed into every country: MAU 2027-12-15 moved −1 to −3% outside China (India −6%). This is how the production cycle's MozillaOnline adjustment behaves too, and was accepted for this draft.

5. Method, in one paragraph each

  • Data. The export's glean_equivalent headline (translated Legacy + steady Glean-only share; excludes the Linux bot-like temporary surges and pre-Fx-148 duplicate-id MAU inflation), 45 OS × country cells for 15 countries plus ROW, 2020-01-01 → 2026-10-09; rounded to whole people. Tiles are Windows / Mac / Linux per country, not production's Windows-version segments, because the translation has no version split.
  • Model. mozaic (Prophet per tile, top-down reconciliation) with the October 2026 desktop lock (cps0.1649_thresh032_recent17_cpr0.814_ncp40_clip0.6_sps0.00825_regimemultiplicative), DAU and MAU fitted independently with the same configuration.
  • Iran. The 2026 shutdown crater is replaced for fitting by a counterfactual fill regenerated for this layout with the production method (scale 1.0 on both metrics); the actuals keep the crater.
  • 2025 Legacy outage. The export inherits Legacy's outage dips (Windows 2025-08-16..11-06, Mac 08-28..12-10); masked as one holiday window so the model does not learn them.
  • Continuation. The export project re-applied its translation to Legacy days 2026-09-09..2026-10-09 (their D-118), with the duplicate-id share and bands carried forward and no new Linux windows detected.

6. Caveats a reader should carry

  • The history is a model translation in the Fx 148–153 Glean state, one version state behind current Firefox; a Fx 155 re-measurement (late October) may reissue the whole series (−0.4% Windows / −0.7% Mac at client level is the known offset to Fx 154).
  • Forecasting the headline means published Glean MAU will sit above it by the duplicate-id floor (~0.5%) plus any open Linux temporary term, unless those are carried as explicit adjustments (registered as candidates, not applied).
  • One extra month of history moved the 2027 headline by +2.8% (build 1 → build 2). The number is sensitive to the autumn 2026 trajectory.
  • China windows MAU declines 18% through 2027 in this build while its DAU rises 12%; China is 4% of the world. Accepted for the draft.
  • Linux is the noisiest OS in the translation (headline 2–4% above published in 2025); its strong upward trend (+17% MAU Dec→Dec) is carried as the data gives it.
  • No comparison forecasts yet (Legacy through today, real Glean from 2025-05-22): next step after this copy.
